readings: For each player in the postseason batting data (matched to `player` on `player_id`), take their average postseason doubles per record, ignoring missing values, along with their batting hand. Divide it by the overall average of these per-player averages to get a relative index. Then show how far each player's index sits above the average index for their batting hand. Give the top 10 players by that gap, largest first (missing last), with player id, batting hand, average doubles, index, and the gap, unrounded. For each player in the postseason batting data (matched to `player` on `player_id`), take their average postseason doubles per record, ignoring missing values, along with their batting hand. Divide it by the overall average of these per-player averages to get a relative index. Then show how far each player's index sits above the average index for their batting hand. Give the top 10 players by that gap, largest first (missing last), with player id, batting hand, average doubles, index, and the gap, unrounded. Exclude players with unknown batting hand from the hand-group averages and from the ranking.
queries:
WITH per_player AS (
    SELECT bp.player_id, p.bats, AVG(bp."double") AS avg_doubles
    FROM batting_postseason bp
    JOIN player p ON bp.player_id = p.player_id
    GROUP BY bp.player_id, p.bats
),
indexed AS (
    SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles,
           avg_doubles / (SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) FROM per_player) AS idx
    FROM per_player
),
final AS (
    SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx,
           idx - AVG(idx) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS gap
    FROM indexed
)
SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx, gap
FROM final
ORDER BY gap DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH pa AS (
  SELECT b.player_id, p.bats, AVG(b."double") AS avg_doubles
  FROM batting_postseason b
  JOIN player p ON p.player_id = b.player_id
  GROUP BY b.player_id, p.bats
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) AS overall_avg FROM pa
),
idx AS (
  SELECT pa.player_id, pa.bats, pa.avg_doubles, pa.avg_doubles / overall.overall_avg AS idx
  FROM pa, overall
),
known AS (
  SELECT * FROM idx WHERE bats IS NOT NULL AND bats <> ''
),
hand AS (
  SELECT bats, AVG(idx) AS hand_idx FROM known GROUP BY bats
)
SELECT k.player_id, k.bats, k.avg_doubles, k.idx AS index_value, k.idx - h.hand_idx AS gap
FROM known k
JOIN hand h ON h.bats = k.bats
ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
